portraits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single transparent fantasy game character portrait.
Input image roles, in priority order:
1. The existing portrait is the IDENTITY reference and edit target. Preserve this exact recognizable character.
2. The front/back render of the actual game model is the authoritative source for clothing, face, hair, proportions, silhouette, materials, and held equipment. Show just ONE character, not front and back.
3. The ten-card polished roster is ONLY a reference for energetic posing, attractive lighting, and portrait presentation. DO NOT borrow its character designs or costumes.
Primary request: Create a more dynamic, beautifully lit portrait of this exact game model. It must immediately look like the model. Keep its simple chunky chibi shapes and large stylized eyes, its same face, skin tone, eye color, hair, beard, hood/helmet, garments, equipment and color blocking. Improve energy with a three-quarter action-ready pose, slight perspective, expressive face, fuller soft shading and controlled rim highlights. Clean stylized 3D illustration, smooth shading over simple broad forms and a few purposeful facets; NOT an intricate armor redesign or photorealistic human.
Composition: square image intended for a 512x512 portrait. Single hero shown head to upper thighs, large readable face, a compact dynamic pose with the equipment held naturally and prominently. Include all hair/crest/horns and weapon tips inside the canvas with 5% breathing room. Center the visual weight. Keep pose readable at 150px.
Background: actual transparent PNG alpha, with empty transparent space around the subject. No backdrop, scene, ground, floor, rectangle, gradient background, painted checkerboard, or cast floor shadow. Bottom of torso may fade subtly into transparency.
Constraints: same character design as images 1 and 2 is the MOST IMPORTANT rule. Do not add armor pieces, spikes, horns, ornaments, fur, capes, emblems, gems, glowing eyes, magical effects or weapons that the model does not have. No change of species. No text, card, border, labels, UI, watermarks, multiple characters, duplicate views, extra arms or extra weapons. Change the pose and rendering quality, not the character design.
